title: The Adventures of Pinocchio
author: Carlo Collodi
summary: A wooden puppet carved by a poor carpenter comes to life and promptly ignores every piece of advice he is given. He lurches from one scrape to the next, learning the cost of lying and laziness.
readIf: you want to meet the original, odder and more moralistic story behind the famous film.
skipIf: you expect the gentle Disney version; the original is episodic and sometimes harsh.

pairings.reason: Another fantastical tale of a child hero who learns and grows through strange adventures.
A classic about a child who refuses to grow up, with the same mix of play and menace.
Another episodic children's classic full of eccentric encounters.
